agent.problem: The card uses the crowd from Luke 8:19 when it describes the message reaching Jesus "through all those people," as well as the message from Luke 8:20. Citing only Luke 8:20 is therefore too narrow; the card uses Luke 8:19-20.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
